company_identity.legal_name: 贵州茅台酒股份有限公司

forecast_handoff.accounting_basis: Attributable net profit excluding immaterial non-recurring items; FY2026-FY2028 are scenario assumptions, not company guidance.

scenario_assumptions.base: FY2026 revenue CNY178.1bn and core net profit CNY86.5bn; FY2027-FY2028 retain mid-single-digit revenue and profit growth as volume/mix recover from the H1 slowdown.
scenario_assumptions.bear: FY2026 revenue CNY174.6bn and core net profit CNY84.0bn; subsequent years assume low-single-digit recovery with persistent channel and price pressure.
scenario_assumptions.bull: FY2026 revenue CNY182.0bn and core net profit CNY89.0bn; subsequent years assume stronger volume and product-mix recovery.
scenario_assumptions.capital: ROE paths assume ordinary cash payout remains near the recent three-year level and no material change in share class.

valuation_handoff.accounting_basis: TTM core attributable profit = FY2025 core profit - H1 2025 core profit + H1 2026 core profit; non-recurring difference is immaterial.
valuation_handoff.roe_average_equity_method: two-point TTM average: (FY2025 ending equity + 2026 H1 ending equity) / 2

dividend_payout_adjustment.formula: N = clamp(50 / three-year ordinary cash-dividend payout %, 1, 2)
dividend_payout_adjustment.note: N remains 1 because the three-year ordinary cash payout is above 50%; repurchases do not enter N.

dupont_ttm.roe_driver: very high net margin with moderate turnover and low leverage

roa_adjustment.formula: TTM core attributable profit / average total assets = 81.3671 / ((303.8348 + 309.0508) / 2)
roa_adjustment.reason: No period mismatch, material acquisition/disposal, financing event or identified non-recurring profit item requires a numerical ROA correction. Consolidated finance-subsidiary assets mean ROA is used only as a quality/leverage check.

price_bands.basis: single-decision-pr-v2; target PE = normalized target × E × decision ROE; price = target PE × core TTM EPS

exit_handoff.anchor_note: H=min(mean, median); high dispersion uses S=0.80*H. Since H>E, M is not applicable and E is the first formal market-risk review line.
exit_handoff.reprice_trigger: new periodic report, profit warning, material change in ordinary cash payout or shares, price movement of 8% from the valuation base

peer_timing.counterevidence: Wuliangye and Luzhou Laojiao made a new 20-day low during the last five sessions; the signal changes timing only, not value or position cap.

position_handoff.portfolio_policy: 5-8 holdings; conditional ladder assumes no current holding and does not override portfolio correlation or user risk budget.

invalidation_triggers: two comparable reporting periods of volume/revenue weakness with margin compression
audit qualification or material governance event
ordinary cash-dividend payout changes enough to alter N
price moves 8 percent from 2026-09-08 or crosses a decision-PR boundary
